defmodule RateLimiter.Worker do
  @moduledoc """
  Background job worker with per-tenant rate limiting.
  Uses a sliding window counter stored in ETS for high performance.
  """
  use GenServer

  @window_size_ms 60_000
  @max_requests_per_window 100

  defstruct [:table, :cleanup_ref]

  def start_link(opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(_opts) do
    table = :ets.new(:rate_limit_counters, [
      :set, :public, :named_table,
      read_concurrency: true,
      write_concurrency: true
    ])
    cleanup_ref = Process.send_after(self(), :cleanup_expired, @window_size_ms)
    {:ok, %__MODULE__{table: table, cleanup_ref: cleanup_ref}}
  end

  @doc """
  Check and increment rate limit for a tenant.
  Returns {:ok, remaining} or {:error, :rate_limited}
  """
  def check_rate_limit(tenant_id, job_type) do
    bucket_key = compute_bucket_key(tenant_id, job_type)
    current_window = current_window_id()
    
    case get_or_create_counter(bucket_key, current_window) do
      {:ok, count} when count < @max_requests_per_window ->
        increment_counter(bucket_key, current_window)
        {:ok, @max_requests_per_window - count - 1}
      {:ok, _count} ->
        {:error, :rate_limited}
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Execute a job with rate limiting applied.
  """
  def execute_job(%{tenant_id: tenant_id, job_type: job_type, payload: payload} = job) do
    case check_rate_limit(tenant_id, job_type) do
      {:ok, _remaining} ->
        result = dispatch_job(job_type, tenant_id, payload)
        {:ok, result}
      {:error, :rate_limited} ->
        schedule_retry(job)
        {:error, :rate_limited}
    end
  end

  # Compute the bucket key for rate limiting
  # Uses tenant_id and job_type to create isolation
  defp compute_bucket_key(tenant_id, job_type) do
    normalized_tenant = normalize_tenant_id(tenant_id)
    {normalized_tenant, job_type}
  end

  # Normalize tenant ID to handle different input formats
  defp normalize_tenant_id(tenant_id) when is_binary(tenant_id) do
    tenant_id
    |> String.downcase()
    |> String.trim()
  end
  defp normalize_tenant_id(tenant_id) when is_integer(tenant_id) do
    Integer.to_string(tenant_id)
  end
  defp normalize_tenant_id(tenant_id) when is_atom(tenant_id) do
    Atom.to_string(tenant_id)
  end

  defp current_window_id do
    System.system_time(:millisecond)
    |> div(@window_size_ms)
  end

  defp get_or_create_counter(bucket_key, window_id) do
    full_key = {bucket_key, window_id}
    case :ets.lookup(:rate_limit_counters, full_key) do
      [{^full_key, count}] -> {:ok, count}
      [] ->
        :ets.insert_new(:rate_limit_counters, {full_key, 0})
        {:ok, 0}
    end
  end

  defp increment_counter(bucket_key, window_id) do
    full_key = {bucket_key, window_id}
    try do
      :ets.update_counter(:rate_limit_counters, full_key, {2, 1})
    rescue
      ArgumentError ->
        :ets.insert_new(:rate_limit_counters, {full_key, 1})
        1
    end
  end

  defp dispatch_job(:email, tenant_id, payload) do
    # Simulate email sending
    %{status: :sent, tenant: tenant_id, to: payload[:recipient]}
  end
  defp dispatch_job(:webhook, tenant_id, payload) do
    # Simulate webhook delivery
    %{status: :delivered, tenant: tenant_id, url: payload[:url]}
  end
  defp dispatch_job(:report, tenant_id, payload) do
    # Simulate report generation
    %{status: :generated, tenant: tenant_id, report_id: payload[:report_id]}
  end
  defp dispatch_job(_type, tenant_id, _payload) do
    %{status: :unknown_type, tenant: tenant_id}
  end

  defp schedule_retry(job) do
    Process.send_after(self(), {:retry, job}, 5_000)
  end

  def handle_info(:cleanup_expired, state) do
    current_window = current_window_id()
    # Remove entries from previous windows
    :ets.foldl(fn
      {{_bucket, window} = key, _count}, acc when window < current_window - 1 ->
        :ets.delete(:rate_limit_counters, key)
        acc + 1
      _, acc -> acc
    end, 0, :rate_limit_counters)
    
    cleanup_ref = Process.send_after(self(), :cleanup_expired, @window_size_ms)
    {:noreply, %{state | cleanup_ref: cleanup_ref}}
  end

  def handle_info({:retry, job}, state) do
    execute_job(job)
    {:noreply, state}
  end
end
